The '''MG7 proton torpedo''' was a model of [[Proton torpedo/Legends|proton torpedo]] manufactured during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]].

==History==
The MG7 saw use with the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] [[BTL-B Y-wing starfighter/Legends|BTL-B Y-wing starfighter]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. It was a popular weapon, valued for both its powerful warhead and exceptional targeting system.
